classification.system_type: real generate-and-test self-improvement loop around an existing agent
classification.candidate_versioning: accepted physical changes are snapshotted and reversible
classification.candidate_local_gate: fixed-time paired statistical gate, not anytime-valid

train_quality_gate.paired_unit: per-case behavior delta on the same cases
train_quality_gate.significance_threshold: one-sided 95% lower confidence bound using z=1.645 when comparable case count >=5
train_quality_gate.notes: The significance calculation uses a sample-standard-error normal bound across per-case deltas. It is a fixed-time test; no confidence sequence/e-process or candidate-family spending was found in the inspected path.

regression_gate.resample_rule: when a candidate shows a raw drop but Wilson intervals still overlap, the case is rerun in steps until separation or the run cap
regression_gate.statistical_scope: ordinary Wilson intervals are repeatedly inspected under adaptive stopping; the inspected code does not upgrade them to anytime-valid intervals

holdout_gate.strict_mode: if the baseline holdout has failures, optionally require positive unseen behavior gain
holdout_gate.interpretation: This is an adaptive promotion surface. A failing auto-holdout can be brought into train by salt rotation while a new unseen set is created, so the role of the surface changes over the optimization history.

evidence_persistence.risk: A valid live decision can exist without its intended evidence artifact; the evidence log is therefore not the sole source of truth from which the statistical state/verdict is reconstructed.

scope_limits: No claim is made that AgentOpt's fixed-time statistics are incorrectly implemented for a single pre-specified look; the issue is repeated/adaptive use across resampling and candidate selection.
No claim is made that auto holdout rotation necessarily overfits in practice; it means the holdout is not a permanently untouched outer surface.
No paper-run performance claim was audited here; this is a code-level mechanism/protocol audit at the pinned public revision.
Two weaker physical-write helper paths are documented by the project itself and are not generalized to the main overlay gate.

stronger_than: single aggregate metric gates without reliability/coverage/critical-case vetoes
weaker_than: Auto-Quant-V2-style terminal read-only outer evaluation namespace
comparison_to_frontier.missing_composition: real self-improvement + candidate-local anytime-valid CERTIFY + durable cross-candidate spending + terminal cache-only OUTER + provider/evaluator write-ahead reconciliation

connector_mutation_incident.remediation_attempt: connector discovery found no branch-delete action; no further probe mutation was attempted
